title: Length of the Gate List
statement: For any natural number $n$ and any finite list $ss$ of straight-line statements on $n$ inputs, the gate list formed from the $n$ input-negation gates followed by one gate for each statement has length $n+|ss|$.
hypotheses_covered: $ss$ is a list of statements on $n$ inputs
